revision_from_v1: Before any outer result was viewed, replace the full JKP CSV scan with a physically cutoff state snapshot and fail-closed artifact provenance.

frozen_label_artifact_exception.reason: The mandated fold42 official labels are pre-existing frozen artifacts whose t+6 exits extend to 2024-01-09. Reuse them for an apples-to-apples comparison, but do not read new CRSP or JKP rows after 2023-12-29.

features.stock_features: the existing 26 price/volume features, built before the point-in-time universe filter and then ranked cross-sectionally by date
features.price_source: panel_kronos_adj.parquet; DlyRet and DlyCap come from panel_raw.parquet

training_label.kind: six-market-session compounded CRSP DlyRet, cross-sectionally demeaned
training_label.construction_order: build on the unfiltered stock history, require exact consecutive market-session positions, then apply the universe anchor filter
training_label.purge: require label_end_date strictly before each inner or outer validation start

inner_validation.tie_break: fewer boosting rounds, then lower structural complexity

final_fit.hyperparameters: one inner-selected configuration per model and outer fold, fixed across all final seeds
final_fit.primary_prediction: arithmetic mean of the three seed predictions for each stock-date key
final_fit.seed_dispersion: standard deviation of the three seed-level 881-day mean RankIC values

evaluation.primary_metric: mean of all 881 concatenated daily RankIC values, matching the exact +0.020667959 Kronos reference
secondary_metrics: simple equal-weight mean of seven fold RankIC values
per-seed primary-metric mean and standard deviation

decision_thresholds.conclusion: The tree model matches or beats Kronos

compute.materialization: date-filtered base cache plus one fold at a time; JKP state columns are expanded into the dense matrix in row chunks
compute.resume: fail closed unless config, pipeline build, cache, package versions, hyperparameters, model, fold, and seed fingerprints all match
